subject: Request: remove prompt logs & generated outputs for Project Orion
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@medalytics.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: remove prompt logs & generated outputs for Project Orion

Hi Mina,

Following up from our compliance review: Medalytics needs Redwood to permanently remove the prompt logs and generated outputs associated with Project "Orion" (customer IDs ORN-213, ORN-214). Scope we require removed: model inputs (prompts), model-generated text outputs, and inference logs (request IDs, KV cache snapshots where retained). Time window: 2025-04-01 through 2026-10-31.

We need:
- Confirmation of what exact artifacts Redwood retains and where (S3 buckets, internal caches).
- A deletion plan and estimated completion window.
- A signed deletion certificate and audit log listing object ids or checksums as proof.

Legal has looped in legal@medalytics.com; they asked for DocuSign approval to trigger deletion. Can you confirm next steps and typical lead time? This is time-sensitive — compliance needs closure before our next audit.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Privacy, Medalytics
elena.park@medalytics.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@medalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: remove prompt logs & generated outputs for Project Orion

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear scope. We can and will execute this. High-level plan:

1) Scope verification: We will map ORN-213/214 across our systems (ingest buckets, prompt-output indices, kv-store snapshots, and short-term inference cache).
2) Ticket + approvals: We'll create a deletion ticket (RED-4583) and require a signed DocuSign authorization from Medalytics (this is standard for cross-account irreversible ops).
3) Execution window: Once we receive the signed DocuSign, ops will run the suppression job and physical delete objects from S3 and our persistent indices. Typical ETA: 3-5 business days for the scope you provided.
4) Proof artifacts: After completion we'll deliver: (a) a deletion certificate PDF signed by our Ops Lead, (b) deletion_audit_log CSV listing object keys + checksums, and (c) internal runbook excerpt describing commands and verification checks. We will also include S3 object tombstone IDs where available.

Questions for you:
- Please confirm any regulatory retention holds that might prevent deletion (e.g., ongoing litigation).
- Do you require an HSM/KMS zeroization statement or is the file-level object deletion and audit log sufficient?

I will attach the ops runbook as reference and create the ticket. Ben (ops) and Rishi (security) are cc'ed to weigh in on tooling and evidence format.

Next step for Medalytics: sign the DocuSign link we will send; once received we begin work.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Park <elena.park@medalytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@medalytics.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 13:28:00 -0800

On Tue, Nov 10, 2026 at 10:05 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I will attach the ops runbook as reference and create the ticket.

Thanks Mina — confirmed, no litigation or hold on our side. KMS zeroization statement is not required for this deletion; file/object-level deletion plus audit log is sufficient for our auditors.

I've reviewed the scope and confirm ORN-213 and ORN-214 as stated. Please proceed. I'll ask Legal to sign the DocuSign; they expect the link by EOD.

Elena Park
Head of Privacy, Medalytics

--
Legal (note): signing will be done by 11/11 if DocuSign arrives today.

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Elena — quick status and final confirmation. Per DocuSign (link: https://docusign.net/medalytics/DS-20261110-ORION, envelope signed by legal@medalytics.com at 2026-11-10T15:20:00Z) we executed the suppression workflow for ORN-213 & ORN-214 this afternoon. Summary of actions performed: 

- Deleted prompt-output objects from bucket redwood-prod-orion-outputs (keys listed in attached CSV).
- Expunged matching indices from prompt-output index cluster (index IDs included in CSV).
- Cleared KV snapshot entries and invalidated short-term inference cache across the serving runtime.
- Captured audit artifacts and uploaded to: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-deletion-proofs/medalytics/20261110/ (read-only link).

Attachments (attached to this email):
- medalytics_deletion_certificate_20261110.pdf (signed by Ops Lead)
- deletion_audit_log_20261110.csv (object keys, checksums, index ids, delete timestamps)
- ops_runbook_promptlog_suppression_v1.pdf (excerpt of commands executed)

Ticket reference: RED-4583 (https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RED-4583). If you need a notarized chain-of-custody or additional PKCS#7-signed evidence, let us know and we will provide next steps.

Closing note: All deletion timestamps are in UTC and the run completed at 2026-11-10T23:02:18Z. Please reply to confirm receipt and acceptance of the deletion certificate for your audit records.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
